new_jobs.description:
Job Summary

Project Manager - Critical Operations IT System Modernization

We are seeking an experienced Contractor Project Manager to lead a high-priority Operations IT initiative focused on developing a new system with the support of AI-assisted development practices to help accelerate, support, and improve aspects of the development process. The effort will support modernization of a current legacy system written in Ingres and OpenROAD and will require close coordination across multiple business, technology, operations, security, data, and vendor teams. This role is ideal for a delivery-focused project manager who can bring structure, urgency, and clear communication to a complex, highly visible project with operational impact.

Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end project planning, execution, tracking, and delivery for a critical Operations IT project focused on developing a new system to replace or modernize the legacy environment.
Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, and status reporting.
Coordinate activities across multiple internal teams, including Operations, IT, application development, data, cybersecurity, infrastructure, change management, compliance, and business stakeholders.
Facilitate working sessions, project meetings, decision reviews, and executive-level updates.
Drive accountability across project contributors and ensure deliverables are completed on time and aligned with scope.
Partner with technical leads and subject matter experts to translate business needs into actionable project tasks and delivery plans.
Coordinate legacy system discovery and modernization planning related to the existing Ingres and OpenROAD environment, including dependencies, integration points, business rules, risks, and transition needs.
Support planning for the responsible use of AI-assisted tools and practices during the development process, including coordination around standards, governance, testing, validation, documentation, and delivery controls.
Identify project risks early, escalate blockers appropriately, and recommend practical mitigation strategies.
Ensure smooth handoffs, documentation, implementation readiness, and post-deployment support planning.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of project management experience leading complex IT, operations technology, application delivery, or enterprise transformation projects.
Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional teams and coordinating work across business and technical stakeholders.
Strong understanding of project management practices, including scope management, schedule management, risk management, issue tracking, dependency management, and stakeholder communications.
Experience delivering projects in fast-paced, mission-critical, or operationally sensitive environments.
Ability to communicate clearly with technical teams, business leaders, executives, vendors, and end users.
Strong meeting facilitation, documentation, follow-up, and decision-tracking skills.
Comfort working on projects where AI-assisted tools, automation, analytics, data-driven practices, or emerging technologies may be used to support delivery.
Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, Jira, Smartsheet, Planner, Teams, SharePoint, or similar platforms.

Preferred Experience

Experience with projects that use AI-assisted development, automation, analytics, data integration, or modern software delivery practices to support implementation.
Experience managing legacy application modernization, replacement, migration, or re-platforming initiatives, especially involving older database or application development environments such as Ingres, OpenROAD, or similar technologies.
Experience working in operations, utility, energy, critical infrastructure, regulated, or high-availability environments.
PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum Master, SAFe, or similar project/program management certification.
Experience managing vendor resources, system integrators, consultants, or third-party technology partners.
Familiarity with change management, training coordination, user adoption, operational readiness, and production support transition planning.

Engagement Details

Role Type: Contractor
Project Area: Operations IT, legacy system modernization, AI-assisted development support, and cross-functional delivery
Work Style: Collaborative, hands-on, delivery-oriented, and highly communicative
Primary Focus: Keeping a critical project organized, visible, actionable, and moving forward across multiple teams

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a proactive, detail-oriented project manager who can quickly understand business priorities, organize complex workstreams, and build alignment across diverse teams. They should be comfortable operating in ambiguity, asking the right questions, escalating risks early, and maintaining momentum on a critical initiative where communication, accountability, and delivery discipline are essential.

Senior Business Analyst – Azure DevOps & UAT

The strongest candidate is a CBAP-certified Senior Business Analyst who can independently lead complex requirements and process-analysis activities while remaining closely connected to delivery, testing, and implementation
.

You know how to challenge unclear requirements, uncover the real business need, model current and future processes, create development-ready requirements, maintain a disciplined Azure DevOps backlog, support UAT, and prepare users for successful adoption.

You are equally comfortable facilitating a stakeholder discovery session, writing detailed requirements, reviewing user stories with a Product Owner, coordinating UAT, analyzing a process gap, and creating the documentation needed to support a successful production release.

Work Location / Schedule

Onsite 3 days a week in Lansing, MI

Project or Role Overview

The Senior Business Analyst will partner with Product Owners, business stakeholders, project leadership, and delivery teams to support discovery, business-process analysis, backlog management, user acceptance testing, training readiness, and implementation activities.

The role requires substantial experience with enterprise requirements analysis, Agile/Scrum delivery, Azure DevOps backlog management, process modeling, UAT, documentation, and business readiness
.

Key Responsibilities

Business Analysis & Process Modeling

Facilitate discovery and requirements-gathering activities with business stakeholders.
Analyze business needs and translate them into clear, actionable requirements.
Develop current-state and future-state process maps.
Create workflow diagrams and business operating procedures.
Identify process-improvement opportunities and operational impacts.
Identify and document manual processes, workarounds, and exception-handling procedures.
Develop end-to-end business and system-interaction diagrams.
Document business rules, validation requirements, and exception-processing logic.

Product Owner & Backlog Support

Partner with Product Owners to refine and maintain product backlogs.
Gather, analyze, clarify, and document requirements supporting epics, features, user stories, and tasks.
Develop and refine user stories and acceptance criteria.
Maintain requirements traceability across development, testing, and implementation.
Provide recommendations regarding business validation and backlog readiness.

User Acceptance Testing

Coordinate User Acceptance Testing activities with business stakeholders.
Develop or support UAT strategies, scenarios, and business-validation plans.
Track UAT execution, test results, defects, and acceptance decisions.
Support end-to-end business-process testing.
Assess business and release readiness.
Maintain UAT evidence and support acceptance recommendations.

Training & Organizational Readiness

Support development of training plans and end-user training materials.
Create job aids, quick-reference guides, process documentation, and operational materials.
Support stakeholder communication, readiness, and adoption activities.
Facilitate training and knowledge-transfer sessions.

Azure DevOps

Maintain and organize Epics, Features, User Stories, and Tasks in Azure DevOps.
Support Kanban and Sprint board management.
Maintain traceability between requirements, testing, and implementation.
Assist with ADO dashboards, queries, reporting, and documentation.

Documentation & Governance

Create and maintain business and technical requirements documentation.
Maintain process, project, training, and reference documentation.
Support compliance with organizational project-delivery and governance standards.
Maintain documentation repositories, knowledge bases, and project wikis.

Required Qualifications

8+ years of experience gathering requirements from users and business stakeholders.
6+ years of experience designing and documenting technical and business requirements.
4+ years of experience working within Agile/Scrum methodologies, processes, and ceremonies.
3+ years of hands-on experience maintaining and organizing Epics, Features, User Stories, and Tasks using Azure DevOps backlog-management tools, including Kanban and Sprint boards.
Current CBAP certification.
Strong business-analysis and requirements-management expertise.
Strong stakeholder facilitation and communication skills.
Strong written documentation capabilities.
Experience translating business needs into actionable requirements.
Experience supporting enterprise technology implementations.

Experience supporting Product Owners in Agile delivery environments.
Experience developing UAT plans, test scenarios, and business-validation strategies.
Experience coordinating User Acceptance Testing.
Experience creating training plans, training materials, job aids, and operational-readiness documentation.

Company Description

Vitro Automotive Glass produces advanced glass products for the world’s most well-known automotive manufacturers. We work collaboratively with our customers to ensure that our glass provides the safety, comfort, efficiency required for today’s modern vehicles.

Vitro Automotive Glass operates glass manufacturing plants, fabrication facilities and distribution centers worldwide that are solely focused on the production of automotive glass. This scale allows us to provide the quality and technology required for large volume OEM production, while bringing that same attention to detail and quality to our automotive replacement glass (ARG) operations.

As the needs of the automotive industry rapidly evolve, Vitro stays ahead of the curve to help automakers, distributors and installers meet the ever-changing standards for safety, efficiency and sustainability. It’s not enough just to meet specifications. We are committed to working collaboratively to deliver whatever comes next.

Position Description

Program Management is responsible for cross-functional management, coordination and delivery of all projects that are assigned to him/her on time and on budget at a level of quality that is acceptable to both Vitro and external customers. The Program Manager uses the OEM Product Development & Launch Process and the systems described within that process.

The Program Manager has primary responsibility to ensure successful OEM program launches and projects as assigned by the Director. This includes meeting project timelines as specified at acceptable cost and quality to satisfy the needs of both Vitro management and the appropriate OEM customer.

The incumbent must have a four-year engineering degree or comparable program management experience with large OEM customers, with a minimum of three years lead experience on successful launches.

The incumbent must possess excellent communication skills (both written and verbal) as well as interpersonal skills of team participation, influencing others, negotiation skills, conflict resolution and problem-solving skills to keep projects moving forward. Other critical skills include presentation skills, safety-orientation, customer service focus and being results-oriented.

You're responsible for the end-to-end management of commercial and GBS launch readiness programs, driving cross-organizational alignment through the delivery of related outputs. This role requires a background in program management and commercial program experience, change management, a strong understanding of private pricing frameworks (and pricing analysis), and experience scaling global, cross-organizational mechanisms.

You have experience in program management ownership, custom pricing strategies, and a background in supporting selling motions. Manage and lead a highly complex program which requires considerable resources and high levels of complex functional and technical integration and knowledge

We combine advanced business management technology with personalized consulting to provide unmatched scale, efficiency, and support. Our advisor-focused culture is built on innovation and advocacy, enabling advisors to offer comprehensive securities and investment advisory solutions to their clients

Lead with Purpose. Partner with Impact

Kestra Financial, a leading provider of wealth management platforms, technology solutions, and investment products empowering independent financial advisors and RIAs nationwide, is seeking a Senior Strategic Implementation Manager.

This role serves as a pivotal execution leader accountable for the disciplined delivery of Kestra Wealth Management’s highest-priority strategic initiatives in investment products and platform capabilities. You will drive the successful launch of new investment products and manage end-to-end launch campaigns while coordinating complex cross-functional projects spanning technology, compliance, business development, and operations.

By implementing and championing agile, Scrum-like cadences and robust portfolio governance practices, you will build transparency, predictability, and accountability across initiatives. Your leadership will ensure that strategic intent translates into measurable business outcomes—including accelerated advisor adoption, revenue contribution from new products, enhanced platform capabilities, and operational excellence.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for a collaborative leader who thrives at the intersection of strategy, execution, and cross-functional influence in a dynamic, growth-oriented wealth management environment.

What You’ll Do:

Own the end-to-end governance and planning that results in successful delivery of priority investment product launches (e.g., alternative investment solutions, insurance products, or curated offerings) and strategic platform implementation initiatives (new advisory revenue vertical, investment program redesign, etc) from concept through post-launch optimization and benefits realization.
Lead the coordination and execution of comprehensive launch campaigns, aligning go-to-market activities including sales enablement, marketing communications, advisor training and onboarding programs, distribution strategy, and adoption tracking to drive rapid uptake and sustained engagement.
Establish and maintain a prioritized portfolio of strategic initiatives for Investment Platforms & Products; drive rigorous sequencing, capacity alignment, funding discipline, and proactive trade-off decisions (scope, timeline, resources, investment) aligned to Kestra’s business objectives and growth priorities.
Partner with Product Management to translate product strategy and roadmap into executable implementation plans with clear milestones, dependencies, and success criteria.
Support Wealth Management platform and product leads by facilitating high-performing cross-functional project teams and workstreams involving:
Technology: Platform development, data integrations (including MDM/medallion architectures), APIs, advisor portals/tools, and infrastructure enhancements.
Compliance & Legal: Product due diligence, regulatory reviews/approvals, disclosures, risk assessments, and ongoing product governance to ensure adherence to SEC, FINRA, fiduciary, and other requirements.
Business: Commercialization strategy, RIA/advisor engagement and feedback loops, distribution channel readiness, pricing/packaging, and P&L impact modeling.
Operations & Finance: Operational readiness, process design, financial tracking, and benefits measurement.
Map and manage complex dependencies, risks, and interdependencies across teams; proactively identify and remove blockers while fostering alignment and shared ownership in a matrixed environment.
Ensure every initiative incorporates appropriate compliance guardrails, risk controls, audit readiness, and change management from the start.
Design, implement, and continuously mature agile delivery operating models tailored to regulated investment product and platform initiatives. This includes establishing Scrum-like cadences (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives), Kanban for workflow transparency and flow optimization, and scaled frameworks (e.g., program-level planning or release management) for larger or interdependent efforts.
Stand up consistent governance rhythms and forums, including steering committees, launch readiness reviews/tollgates, dependency management sessions, risk reviews, and clear escalation paths to executive leadership.
Drive adoption of modern agile/project tools (Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or equivalent) and best practices to improve delivery velocity, predictability, collaboration, and quality across technology and business teams.
Champion a shift toward iterative, outcome-focused delivery—balancing the need for structure and compliance in product launches with the speed and adaptability required in a competitive wealth tech landscape.
Build and operate a portfolio “control tower” capability: deliver timely, credible, decision-oriented reporting and dashboards on initiative status, milestones, risks/issues, dependencies, financial performance (budget vs. plan, ROI tracking), and leading indicators of business impact.
Define, track, and report on key business outcome metrics tied to each strategic initiative (e.g., new product net flows/AUM/revenue contribution, advisor adoption and usage rates, client/advisor satisfaction or NPS impact, reduction in time-to-market or launch cycle time, compliance adherence, platform feature utilization and engagement).
Proactively surface execution risks, capacity constraints, and recommended trade-offs to senior leadership; lead structured issue resolution, corrective action planning, and recovery efforts to protect delivery commitments and protect/enhance business results.
Prepare and present high-quality materials for executive leadership, steering committees, and governance forums; represent the delivery health and outlook of the Investment Platforms & Products portfolio with clarity and fact-based insights.
Instill a culture of genuine accountability—where teams own and are measured on the delivery of agreed business outcomes and value realization, not merely activity completion or milestone hitting.

What You Bring: 

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or Software Engineering.
2+ years experience in technical product management in an Agile environment.
5+ years of experience in wealth management, investment operations, or trading
3-5+ years of progressive leadership experience in strategic program/portfolio management, product implementation, launch execution, or enterprise transformation roles within wealth management, RIA platforms, investment product development, fintech, asset/wealth platforms, or similarly complex, regulated financial services environments.
Demonstrated success leading multiple end-to-end launches of investment products or major platform capabilities, including coordination across technology builds, compliance/regulatory approvals, and go-to-market execution
Direct experience with alternatives/private markets access, model portfolios, structured solutions, or advisor-facing technology platforms within a broker dealer organization is strongly preferred.
Track record of successfully implementing or significantly maturing agile delivery practices (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, hybrid, or tailored approaches) in product development or regulated contexts, with quantifiable improvements in predictability, velocity, and time-to-value.

Work in a supportive, collaborative environment committed to professional excellence
Help clients navigate meaningful financial decisions with confidence
Opportunities for training, development, and long-term growth within the firm
Tuition reimbursement for qualified expenses

Our Mission is Powering Financial Independence, enabling the growth and success of investing clients and the advisors who serve them. We do that by living our values: Serve, Make it Happen, and One team.

We build user-facing products, and backend platforms to ensure Stripe’s users are compliant with regulatory and financial partner requirements. As a Technical Program Manager in the Risk and Compliance space, you will play a key role across engineering, product, and strategy to drive programs that span across the Risk organization and Stripe. Execute on technical programs that require deep systems and engineering knowledge.
Partner with Engineering Managers, Product Managers and other cross functional partners to define, scope, and drive large programs to conclusion.
Develop, implement, and iterate on program management techniques, frameworks, and KPIs to achieve goals with well defined success criteria.
Make substantial improvements to how the teams you work with communicate and operate to significantly increase the productivity and efficiency of the teams.
Define and produce high quality written proposals, communications and documentation.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
SteadyIQ is hiring its first dedicated Senior Project Manager to own project execution discipline across our government implementation portfolio. You will run the plan, the record, and the cadence for three to four concurrent state agency engagements, and you will be the reason nothing falls between the cracks.
This is a delivery and project controls role. It is not a technical authority role and it is not an client ownership role.

The work runs in two registers, and you need to be fluent in both. Internally, we want the lightest process that is actually effective. Externally, engagements that involve partners with demanding project management expectations, their own artifacts, their own gates, and their own reporting cadence. When a client PMO asks for the full apparatus, you deliver it in their format, to their standard, without issues. This is critical in underscoring SteadyIQ’s purpose-built for government mission and white-glove service throughout the customer journey.

How This Role Fits

Every implementation is staffed as a three person pod. Clear ownership across the three roles is what keeps us fast- and effective.
Senior Project Manager (YOU):
The plan, the record, the cadence, and the portfolio picture. Owns project management practice with the client and the reporting the rest of us rely on.
Solutions Architect:
Source of truth for product and technical questions. Leads technical discovery and integration proof of concept. Pulls in engineering and product as needed.
Client Delivery/ Success:
The business relationship and program domain expertise. Leads business discovery. Carries the relationship through go-live into ongoing steady-state client management.

Key Responsibilities

Project Governance and Documentation

Own the project plan for each assigned engagement: work breakdown, schedule, critical path, milestones, dependencies, and baseline change history.
Maintain the RAID log and decision log, for every engagement, and drive open items to closure rather than simply recording them.
Run the meeting mechanics that keep an engagement moving: agendas, minutes, follow ups, and status reporting on a predictable cadence.
Keep documentation current and audit ready, so any internal or client stakeholder can reconstruct what was decided, when, and why.

Portfolio Visibility

Produce the consolidated view across all assigned engagements, giving leadership, product, engineering, and sales one place to see status, risk, and what is coming next.
Surface cross project patterns: repeated blockers, recurring risks, resource contention, and dependency collisions between engagements.
Flag slippage early and with enough specificity that the pod can act on it.

Client and Partner PMO Interface

Serve as SteadyIQ's project management counterpart to the agency project manager and to System Integrator PMOs.
Represent SteadyIQ on all project management topics for assigned engagements: methodology, artifacts, schedule, governance, reporting, and change control.
Operate inside the client's process, tooling, and templates when required, and produce their artifacts to their standard.

Process and Playbook Contribution

Apply SteadyIQ's implementation playbook to each new engagement and adapt it to that agency's own implementation lifecycle, gate structure, and approval model.
Contribute improvements back to the playbook. While owned by the PMO manager, we want everyone who uses it to make it better.
Help mature the templates, checklists, and reusable artifacts so that our sixth engagement runs more smoothly than our second.

What Makes This Role Interesting

Our platform implementation is increasingly repeatable. However, every agency we deploy it for is starting from scratch and will follow its own process to get there. The central skill in this role is holding one internal playbook stable while re-expressing it in each agency's format and vocabulary, so that our team runs the same play every time while the client experiences their own process being followed properly.

Qualifications

Required

Experience. 6+ years managing complex software or SaaS implementation projects, including direct experience delivering to state or local government agencies.
Project management fluency. You know the standard artifact set cold and can speak PMP with a client PMO.
Client PMO experience. Demonstrated success operating inside a client's or System Integrator's project management environment, using their tools and templates on their cadence.
Process building. A track record of establishing repeatable process where none existed, without over engineering it.
Documentation discipline and responsiveness. Our most demanding government clients ask for artifacts on short notice. Turnaround speed is part of the standard, not a nice to have.
Technical literacy. Enough fluency to sit on an integration or API design discussion, follow it, and capture dependencies and risks accurately.

Preferred

PMP certification. Strongly preferred. PMI-ACP, CSM, CAPM, or SAFe are a plus.
Modern tooling. Experience with project management tooling, especially Microsoft Project (used extensively in government) is preferred. We are open to better tools, with one firm constraint: whatever we adopt has to port cleanly to Microsoft Project for client consumption.
AI proficiency. We do NOT use AI for the sake of using AI. We ARE aggressively pursuing AI initiatives that deliver real, provable value at streamlining efficiency and experience and openness to the use of AI tools is highly desired.
Program domain. Familiarity with public benefits programs such as SNAP, Medicaid, or TANF, with eligibility systems, or with income and employment verification.
Public sector operations. Working knowledge of state IT governance, security review processes, inter agency data sharing, and public sector procurement cycles.

How We Work

Our customers like us, and we treat that as a professional standard. Government relationships compound over years. Agencies expand scope, renew, and refer us based partly on whether their team enjoys working with ours. We want a project manager a client PMO is glad to see on the invite.
Rigor without bureaucracy. We want systems that save the team time. We are not interested in process that requires ten meetings to change one line of code.
Ownership. You will not have an army of support staff. You will own the problem, from the steering committee status deck down to the open action item nobody else has chased.

Logistics

Portfolio. Three to four concurrent engagements.
Travel. Occasional, and genuinely valued rather than required. In person time builds relationships across an agency team in a way calls do not. We do not expect heavy travel.
Background and compliance. Because of the sensitivity of state data and client specific requirements, this position is subject to background check procedures beyond standard employment background check. These may include, but are not limited to, state specific criminal history checks, fingerprinting, and drug testing.

Total Compensation Package

The base salary range for this position is $150,000 - $180,000.
This position is eligible for equity.
We offer a 100% company-paid benefits package for employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision. SteadyIQ maintains a positive work environment with unlimited time off and future growth opportunities within the company.
This compensation and benefits information is based on SteadyIQ’s good faith estimate as of the date of publication and may be modified in the future at the discretion of the company. The level of pay within the range will depend on a variety of job-related factors that may include relevant prior experience and/or education, or particular skills and experience.

About SteadyIQ

SteadyIQ provides modern income and eligibility verification solutions for public sector programs. Our platform helps government agencies streamline complex verification workflows, improve data accuracy, reduce administrative burden, and deliver a more efficient experience for both caseworkers and benefit applicants.

Built with deep experience in public benefits, income verification, and non-traditional employment, SteadyIQ supports a wide range of income types, including W-2, gig work, self-employment, and other variable income sources. Our solutions help agencies make faster, more confident eligibility decisions while maintaining strong standards for consent, security, auditability, and program integrity.

For more information, visit us at www.steadyiq.com.

Steady Platform Inc. (SteadyIQ) is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer – All qualified applicants/employees will receive consideration for employment without regard to that individual’s age, race, color, religion or creed, national origin or ancestry, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, physical or mental disability, veteran status, genetic information, ethnicity, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.

SteadyIQ is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

new_jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Finance Operations (FinOps) team provides and enhances core business services that are the backbone of Stripe. FinOps uses data and operational excellence to deliver technology solutions, payroll services, operational excellence, and monetization services to Stripe.

What you'll do

We're looking for a Monetization Operations Analyst to join our growing team. You'll help us improve user experience through accurate and timely onboarding of contracts and workflows, and deliver improvements in our integrated financial systems with business partners, financial colleagues, and engineers.

Responsibilities

Onboard sold custom contracts into our billing systems.
Work with legal contracts with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Develop and manage scalable billing and collection processes for complex user agreements and new business operations.
Build scalable and auditable onboarding processes for new and existing users.
Partner with internal systems, global deal management, legal, sales ops, internal audit, go-to-market, engineering, and accounting teams to develop and improve processes for contract reviews and to anticipate changing business requirements.
Partner with account managers to resolve user inquiries related to onboarding implementation, billing, and collections.
Advocate for the customer to internal stakeholders. Share system feedback and insights with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Support, and Legal on innovation and improvements needed to optimize the Stripe user experience.
Help scope, build, and deliver continuous process improvements that enhance operations.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

5+ years of experience in a client-facing role, ideally in customer success, consulting, financial services, account management, or sales, preferably working with technical products.
Track record of leading technical conversations and persuading others to take action based on requirements and value provided by solutions.
Ability to be detail-oriented while visualizing the larger impact of a series of transactions.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate data and people to find answers.
Strong operating rigor, including organizational and time management skills.
Ability to work well with a wide range of people, both internally and externally, including working with a team of sales and services peers.
Motivation and flexibility to work well in a high-growth environment where things change quickly.

Preferred Qualifications

Ability to trace process impacts from situation to end customers and business financial outcomes.
Knowledge of or experience in the payments industry.
Demonstrated professional experience using GSuite, Excel, and working with large data sets.
Experience with SQL.
Demonstrated project management or consulting experience and the ability to work cross-functionally.
A builder's mindset and a willingness to question assumptions and conventional wisdom.
A passion for learning and solving problems through infrastructure and automation.

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
